field_states.MAPPED_VALUE: Bounded value recipe; validate against target property schema; if not representable hold whole field, no invented substitution.

canonical_ref_binding.rule: Resolve exact stage triple against an authorized, pinned source-to-canonical mapping and target package manifest; check target kind, owner, direct dependency, version, stable_id, target digest, IF01 endpoint rules, rights and scope. For standard_ref follow exact levelBand then version; never cast stage refs or fabricate missing refs. Absent, multiple, wrong kind or unqualified-for-use target -> HOLD.

canonical_provenance_binding.rule: Use a private adapter that exposes a pinned JSON document (e.g. deterministic array of complete source rows in authorized private root), verifies whole-document SHA256, exact source line SHA and row identity, and resolves JSON pointer to the exact row. Relative path confined to authorized private root; source_status PRIVATE_PRESERVATION_CANDIDATE. Do not invent file/path, use row hash as document hash, apply JSON pointer directly to JSONL, or expose private data in Git/general importer. Until actual document and resolver exist HOLD provenance.

raw_field_projection.rule: For allowlisted literal predicates resolve exact raw terms by unique short name in original predicate index. Each must be one literal with exact non-whitespace string value and valid DB01 name. Emit array of {name,value} sorted by name; preserve value verbatim without trim/normalization. Missing, duplicate short names, multiple terms, IRI instead of literal, blank or invalid term -> HOLD entire field. Do not coerce to null or partial array. IRI links, datatype, language, unknown fields and full arrays stay authoritative in raw_rdf; projected array never substitutes for source evidence.
